summary: Capital Bancorp's bank subsidiary, Capital Bank N.A., signed a purchase and assumption agreement on September 29, 2026 to sell its North Riverside, Illinois branch to another financial institution, which buys certain branch loans/assets and assumes roughly $123.9 million of deposits as of June 30, 2026. Based on that deposit mix, the Bank would have received an approximately $3.3 million deposit premium, plus payment equal to transferred loans' unpaid principal balance. Loan selection occurs within 30 days; closing awaits customary conditions and regulatory approvals. Luse Gorman, PC advises the Bank. Watch regulatory timing and final deposit/loan balances.
